lines.text: It’s project time! Build a leaderboard: collect any number of scores into a list, sort them highest-first with your sorting procedure, announce the top three, and handle edge cases like fewer than three players.
Ask how many players, collect each score into a list, sort it from highest to lowest, and announce the top three.
swap (i) and a sort procedure from Lesson 5 make the main script short: collect, sort, report.
Handle these so the app never shows nonsense.
Use test sets you can check: already sorted, reverse sorted, with ties, and with just one player.
Great work! Let’s remember what we learned.
